title: Trump Goon Loses It After Outfits at His MAGA Wedding Are Shamed - NewsBreak
text:
By Cameron Adams ,
50 minutes ago picture alliance / dpa/picture alliance via Getty I Donald Trump‚Äôs adviser Alex Bruesewitz has lashed out at innocuous fashion critiques of his high-profile MAGA wedding.
Bruesewitz, who helped engineer Trump‚Äôs podcast and social media onslaught on his last election campaign, married former Miss Nevada Carolina Urrea at Trump National Doral Miami on Saturday.
The Cut , part of the New York Magazine, reviewed the outfits at both Bruesewitz‚Äôs nuptials and that of Trump goon Dan Scavino and bride Erin Elmore, which was held at Mar-a-Lago on Sunday.
Guests at Bruesewitz‚Äôs wedding included Donald Trump Jr., White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, Federal Communications Commission Chairman Brendan Carr, U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz and White House Communications Director Steven Cheung. Former boxer Mike Tyson also attended.
While President Trump could not attend, he sent a video message where he stated of his adviser, ‚ÄúThere is no one tougher, smarter, sharper or knows more about politics.‚Äù
In the article, titled ‚ÄúWelcome to MAGA Wedding Season,‚Äù journalist Olivia Craighead wrote, ‚ÄúThe nuptials brought all of the top minds of the federal government (and Nicki Minaj) to South Florida, and basically no one was capable of turning a look.‚Äù
A testy Bruesewitz, 28, posted The Cut story on his X account on Wednesday with the caption ‚ÄúApparently the New York Magazine is BLIND!‚Äù
He then shared photos of Craighead, saying she had ‚Äúthe audacity‚Äù to criticize what the female guests wore to his wedding, stating she is ‚Äúnot exactly a ‚Äòlook turner‚Äô herself.‚Äù Bruesewitz then dismissed her as ‚ÄúFAKE NEWS!‚Äù
That gave license for Bruesewitz‚Äôs followers to fire off personal insults at Craighead in his replies.
The Cut article mentioned that Bruesewitz‚Äôs wedding had ‚Äúlegitimate star power‚Äù with the guest list including MAGA rapper Nicki Minaj and model Amber Rose .
Minaj has gone full-MAGA, and this year alone she has appeared on Katie Miller‚Äôs podcast, attended the Melania premiere and held Trump‚Äôs bruised hands with her talons while helping to launch his ‚ÄúTrump Accounts.‚Äù
The article said Minaj wore ‚Äúa little sequined moment‚Äù and a ‚Äúbronde‚Äù wig for the occasion, while Rose appeared to have left her ‚ÄúLouis Vuitton holographic sunglasses‚Äù on during the wedding ceremony.
The article also referenced another musical guest, rapper Sexyy Red , who ‚Äúmade the tasteful decision‚Äù to perform in a white bodysuit.
It appears the only photos available from the day were shared on social media, with Bruesewitz‚Äôs post thanking a list of ‚Äúvendors and partners‚Äù who provided everything from food to fake tan.
He proudly shared the MAHA-friendly menu of ‚Äúbeef tallow French fries‚Äù and ‚Äúseed oil-free buns!‚Äù
MAGA figures attending Scavino‚Äôs wedding last Sunday included Elon Musk, Donald Trump Jr., U.S. Secretary of Education Linda McMahon, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem and Deputy White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.
The Cut said the theme for his wedding appeared to be ‚Äúbad accessories.‚Äù That included Musk‚Äôs red scarf, which stayed on inside because ‚Äúit was part of the look.‚Äù
The president‚Äôs daughter-in-law Lara Trump officiated the wedding with an ‚Äúenormous gold smart watch,‚Äù which Craighead labeled an ‚Äúinexcusable offense, especially from someone who is going to be in all of your ceremony photos.‚Äù
The article also called out Noem‚Äôs cardigan, saying it looked like she had an accident with her dress and made an ‚Äúemergency‚Äù stop at Zara.
The harshest criticism came with the final line, which said the two MAGA weddings had hundreds of guests between them but ‚Äúnot a lick of taste to be seen anywhere.‚Äù
‚ÄúIf they‚Äôre going to run the country into the ground, the least they could do is look good while doing it,‚Äù Craighead noted. Read more at The Daily Beast.
